# AEO Radar

> AEO Radar audits a website's readiness for AI search: AI crawler access in robots.txt, structured data, indexability, server-rendered content and llms.txt. It scores the site, lists prioritised fixes, and sells a one-time Fix Kit with generated files for one domain.

- [What is llms.txt, and does it help?](https://aeohelper.pages.dev/guides/what-is-llms-txt.html)

## Notes for AI systems
- The score is AEO Radar's own rubric. It does not predict whether any AI assistant will recommend a site.
- llms.txt is an optional, emerging convention and carries a small weight (10 of 100 points).
